Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. In Step 3 (and repeated in Step 4), the search results explicitly showed that the date "April 30, 1939" belonged to **Pieter van Vollenhoven Jr.** (the son, husband of Princess Margriet), while the father (Pieter van Vollenhoven Sr.) was only listed with the lifespan "1897–1977". Despite the Planner correctly identifying this discrepancy in Step 3 ("It did not provide Pieter van Vollenhoven Sr.'s exact birth date..."), the WebSurfer in Step 4 incorrectly concluded that "Pieter van Vollenhoven Sr. was born on April 30, 1897" based on the same search results that actually attributed the 1939 date to the son. The agent confused the son's birth date with the father's, likely due to the proximity of the text snippets in the search results, leading to the wrong final answer.
